rules: Candidates are questions, not admitted or recommended configurations; check pinned source constraints before launch.
Freeze exact token IDs, template, sampling, budgets, source/model/image hashes and cache conditions before paired runs.
Change one meaningful variable; KVarN on/off uses same experimental image because sampler repairs are active.
Current eager wrapper also disables overlap and autotune; it is an execution bundle, not a graph-only attribution.
No percentages are combined across fixtures. Report unavailable telemetry as null, not zero.
Prime Envs owns quality scoring; engineering diagnostics do not qualify model capability.
Near-max depth must be within the proven usable context minus output and engine reserve; do not silently clamp.
Unsupported FP4, recurrent precision, block size or graph combinations must be recorded as unsupported, not GPU measurements.
